findings.title: before_validation crashes on nil host
findings.body: In app/models/embeddable_host.rb the before_validation block calls self.host.sub! twice without checking presence. If host is nil or missing (e.g. admin submits blank host), this raises NoMethodError on nil instead of failing validation. Consequence: POST/PUT to Admin::EmbeddableHostsController with blank host returns 500 instead of a 422 validation error and breaks the admin UI error path.

findings.title: Update/destroy do not handle missing record
findings.body: In app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb update does EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first then calls save_host(host), and destroy does the same lookup then host.destroy. If the id does not exist host is nil, so save_host(nil) calls nil.host= and nil.destroy raises NoMethodError. Consequence: requesting a non-existent id causes a 500 exception instead of a 404/not-found response.

findings.title: Migration assumes site_settings rows exist
findings.body: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb line 9 does execute("SELECT c.id ... WHERE s.name='embed_category'")[0]['id'].to_i without nil checks. On a fresh install where embed_category was never persisted there are zero rows, so [0] is nil and ['id'] raises. Consequence: rake db:migrate fails for new databases.

findings.title: Migration SQL-injects host value
findings.body: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration builds INSERT with string interpolation: VALUES ('#{h}', ... ) where h comes from the old embeddable_hosts site setting split by newline. A host containing a single quote breaks the SQL and allows SQL injection/error. Consequence: migration can fail or execute unintended SQL; must use quoting/sanitization or ActiveRecord models.

findings.title: Migration inserts unnormalized hosts that never match
findings.body: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the loop inserts raw setting lines h directly, bypassing EmbeddableHost normalization that strips scheme and path. Old settings commonly contain values like http://discourse.org or https://example.com/1234, so the new table ends up with scheme/path included. EmbeddableHost.record_for_host compares URI.host (bare hostname) to the stored string, so those migrated rows never match. Consequence: embedding silently stops working after upgrade.

findings.title: Host lookup is case-sensitive and ignores port mismatch
findings.body: In app/models/embeddable_host.rb record_for_host does where("lower(host) = ?", host) where host is uri.host as-is, without downcasing, so lower(stored) is compared to mixed-case input and uppercase URLs miss. Additionally validation allows host:port but lookup extracts uri.host without port, so a stored example.com:3000 never equals example.com. Consequence: legitimate embed URLs are rejected as invalid referer host.

findings.title: _hydrateEmbedded crashes on null plural ids
findings.body: In app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/store.js.es6 _hydrateEmbedded for keys matching *_ids does obj[k].map(...) with no array guard. If the server serializes an empty association as null/undefined instead of [], this throws TypeError. Consequence: store.find/findAll for any model with a null plural id field crashes the client; should check Array.isArray or fallback to [].

findings.title: Fabricator file contents are swapped
findings.body: In spec/fabricators/category_fabricator.rb the file now defines Fabricator(:embeddable_host) while spec/fabricators/embeddable_host_fabricator.rb defines Fabricator(:category) and related categories. The contents are in the wrong files. It still loads but is misleading and will confuse maintainers; the definitions should be moved back to their matching filenames.

findings.title: No real coverage for new admin endpoints
findings.body: In spec/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller_spec.rb and embedding_controller_spec.rb the only test is that the controller is a subclass of AdminController. There is no coverage for create/update/destroy validation, 404 handling, auth (admin vs moderator/anon), category fallback, or serialization. Consequence: regressions in the new embedding admin API, including the nil-handling and validation bugs above, will not be caught.
